title: Unreal Ice Mango Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Unreal Ice Mango Ice Shortfill delivers the vibrant sweetness of ripe, juicy mango with a refreshing twist of icy menthol. This tropical combination offers a perfectly balanced vape that blends fruity, sun-kissed mango with a brisk menthol finish, making it ideal for vapers who love a refreshing yet fruity vape. Each Unreal Ice Shortfill contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, leaving 20ml of space to add nicotine shots. For example, adding 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots will create 120ml of 3mg nicotine strength e-liquid. Simply shake well, and your e-liquid is ready to enjoy. Unreal Ice Shortfills are crafted with a 70VG/30PG blend, making them ideal for sub-ohm vaping with high-powered devices and low-resistance coils. The higher VG content ensures dense vapour production and smooth flavour, perfect for creating satisfying clouds and full-bodied flavour. Dispergo E-Liquids’ Unreal Ice collection combines refreshing menthol with rich and fruity flavours for an exceptional vaping experience. Whether you prefer tropical fruits, menthol, or sweet confectionery blends, Unreal Ice offers a full-flavoured vape with a frosty finish.
